notes.W7154454518: Across 783,000 memory tests in five cohorts, later-born people both start old age with better memory and decline more slowly. That double dividend is large enough to explain the ~13% per-decade fall in dementia incidence. Observational, but a bounding analysis tests period assumptions.
notes.W7160534229: Most 'nonadditive' genetic signals in UK Biobank, including 97% of variance QTLs, vanish once the trait is put on a data-learned scale between linear and log. Additive discovery rises 11% and prediction 10%. A warning that measurement scale can manufacture biology.
notes.W7155623016: An evolutionary-algorithm design method builds a bi-zinc phosphatase from scratch, with no natural template or motif, reaching a 10^13-fold rate enhancement comparable to natural enzymes and confirmed by crystallography. Enzyme design without borrowing from evolution's catalogue becomes plausible.
notes.W3123613249: Prior estimates of benefit extensions only counted how the unemployed search. Adding employers' vacancy decisions, the authors find extensions raised wages, cut job creation and raised unemployment in the Great Recession. Identification of equilibrium effects remains the contested part.
notes.W7134035209: Two full algorithms (QAOA and HHL) run end to end using only fault-tolerant components on trapped ions, up to 12 logical qubits, with a logical T-gate infidelity of 2.7×10^-3. Performance is near break-even, not better than unencoded, but the full stack now exists.
notes.W7236335327: 43 radiometric ages place Homo erectus in southern China until ~184,000 years ago, and isotopes show it living in closed rainforest, a habitat assumed to be modern humans' alone. The species' ecological range was wider than its Javan grassland sites implied.
notes.W7165116167: Strongly magnetised neutron stars align their magnetic and spin axes faster (τ ∝ B^-2), shrinking their radio beams and hiding them. Correcting for this, pulsars and magnetars fit one log-uniform birth field distribution; the famous gap may be an observational artefact.
notes.W7225627285: In a 40-week RCT of 120 adults on tirzepatide, thrice-weekly resistance training left weight loss unchanged (~22 kg) but saved 1.1 kg of lean mass and turned strength losses into gains. Modest sample, but a clear, actionable adjunct.
notes.W7236185240: Screening 3,975 single-cell datasets down to 258 (15 million cells, 42 cancer types, human and mouse), the authors find shared stromal and immune programs responding to malignancy regardless of organ. Released as an atlas and software, it is mainly a resource.
notes.W7162543134: A kinetic Monte Carlo model parametrised from all-atom simulation reproduces how hepatitis B capsid modulators steer hundreds of subunits toward malformed shells, and names the decisive intermediates. A template for multiscale simulation of drug-redirected self-assembly.

thread: The unemployment-benefit and tirzepatide papers make the same correction in different fields: the first measurement counted only the direct channel. Benefit studies tracked job search but missed employers cutting vacancies; weight-loss trials tracked kilograms but not which tissue was lost. Both results change once the second channel is measured.

notes.W7236305771: Shifts: interstitial oxygen in metals was modelled as randomly distributed, because no one could see it → 3D ptychography shows correlated occupancy forming nanoscale ordered domains. Defect models used for strength, transport and phase stability now need short-range order built in.
notes.W4416048293: Shifts: Huang and Yang's 1957 three-term energy formula for a dilute Fermi gas was a physicist's prediction → it is now a theorem with matching upper and lower bounds. The universality claim, that only the scattering length matters, is now rigorously established.
notes.W4411174673: Shifts: genotype-phenotype maps were treated as fixed backdrops for evolution → selection itself optimises the map, maximising the number of genotypes that encode fit phenotypes. Regulatory parameters can be predicted from an optimality principle without full molecular mechanism.

foundation.title: Apparent structure can come from how you measure
foundation.principle: Before explaining a pattern, ask whether the measurement made it. In neutron stars, the gap between pulsars and magnetars looks like two populations, but faster axis alignment in strong fields shrinks radio beams and hides high-field pulsars; correct for that selection and one continuous birth distribution remains. In UK Biobank, most gene-gene and variance effects disappear once traits are put on the right scale: the nonadditivity came from the ruler, not the genome. The titanium-oxygen fundamentals paper is the converse: 'randomness' was assumed only because nobody could image the atoms. The same check applies to survey weighting, detection limits in clinical biomarkers, and any histogram drawn from a filtered sample.
rests_on: Box, G. E. P. & Cox, D. R. (1964). An Analysis of Transformations
Fisher, R. A. (1918). The Correlation between Relatives on the Supposition of Mendelian Inheritance
foundation.question: Can we build general tests that tell a measurement-induced pattern from a real one when the true scale or selection function is unknown?

W7154454518.question: Is falling dementia incidence due to higher starting cognition, slower decline, or both?
W7154454518.approach: ~783,000 episodic memory assessments from ~219,000 people in five longitudinal Western cohorts, compared by birth cohort.
W7154454518.finding: Later cohorts start higher and decline slower; the 20-year cohort advantage at 80 could explain the 13% per-decade incidence drop.
W7154454518.implication: Lifespan environment reshapes cognitive ageing itself, not just reserve; gains concentrate in fastest decliners.

W7160534229.question: Does the default scale of a phenotype distort inferences about its genetic architecture?
W7160534229.approach: SIQReg learns a Box–Cox scale minimising heterogeneity across phenotype quantiles; tested on 25 UK Biobank traits.
W7160534229.finding: Default scale rejected for 24/25; 97% of vQTLs removed; GWAS loci +11%, TWAS genes +13%, prediction +10%.
W7160534229.implication: Many reported nonadditive genetic effects may be scale artefacts; choose the scale before claiming interaction.

W7155623016.question: Can a functional enzyme be designed with no natural template, motif or evolutionary information?
W7155623016.approach: dEVA, a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm, optimises a metal coordination sphere; design checked by crystallography and absorption spectroscopy.
W7155623016.finding: A bi-zinc hydrolase with rate enhancement up to 3×10^13 on phosphomono- and diesters, comparable to natural phosphatases.
W7155623016.implication: Zero-shot de novo enzyme design reaches natural-level catalysis, widening the space of designable chemistry.

W3123613249.question: How did unemployment benefit extensions affect unemployment once employer responses are included?
W3123613249.approach: A new methodology measuring equilibrium effects on job creation, applied to Great Recession benefit extensions.
W3123613249.finding: Extensions raised equilibrium wages, sharply cut vacancy creation and employment, and raised unemployment.
W3123613249.implication: Search-only estimates understate the labour-market cost of benefit extensions.

W7134035209.question: Can complete quantum algorithms run using only fault-tolerant, error-corrected components?
W7134035209.approach: QAOA and HHL (Poisson equation) on Quantinuum H2/Helios using the [[7,1,3]] Steane code with dynamic circuits.
W7134035209.finding: Up to 12 logical (97 physical) qubits, 2,132 two-qubit gates, better than random; logical T infidelity 2.7×10^-3.
W7134035209.implication: End-to-end fault-tolerant algorithms work near break-even; more error-correction cycles measurably help.

W7236335327.question: When, and in what environments, did Homo erectus live in southern China?
W7236335327.approach: 43 radiometric ages from five techniques; stable and clumped isotopes and trace elements from nine teeth.
W7236335327.finding: H. erectus present 324–184 ka, well after the ~400 ka previously known, living in closed rainforest.
W7236335327.implication: Rainforest adaptation was not unique to Homo sapiens; erectus was more ecologically flexible than assumed.

W7165116167.question: Why is there a gap in magnetic field strength between observed pulsars and magnetars?
W7165116167.approach: Analytic coupled spin-down and inclination evolution; correct observed fields for beaming and luminosity selection.
W7165116167.finding: Alignment time scales as B^-2, hiding strong-field pulsars; one log-uniform initial field distribution fits both.
W7165116167.implication: Pulsars and magnetars may be one population seen through different selection effects.

W7225627285.question: Does resistance exercise reduce lean mass loss during tirzepatide therapy?
W7225627285.approach: Two-arm RCT, 120 adults on tirzepatide, thrice-weekly resistance training vs usual activity for 40 weeks.
W7225627285.finding: Weight loss equal (~22 kg); lean loss 3.57 vs 4.67 kg (diff 1.09 kg); strength rose with training, fell without.
W7225627285.implication: Resistance training is an effective adjunct preserving muscle and function on incretin therapy.

W7236185240.question: Are tumour microenvironment responses shared across cancer types and species?
W7236185240.approach: Algorithmic screen of 3,975 public scRNA-seq datasets; 258 retained covering 42 cancers, >2,000 human and mouse samples.
W7236185240.finding: Conserved stromal and immune transcriptional hallmarks of response to malignancy across organs and species.
W7236185240.implication: Provides a pan-cancer atlas and scTME package for systematic TME comparison and mouse-human translation.

W7162543134.question: How do capsid assembly modulators redirect hepatitis B capsid self-assembly?
W7162543134.approach: Kinetic Monte Carlo assembly model parametrised from all-atom simulations, validated against biochemical and structural data.
W7162543134.finding: Reproduces CAM-induced product distributions and identifies key intermediates leading to capsids versus malformed structures.
W7162543134.implication: Separates kinetic from thermodynamic control, guiding antiviral design and directed nanocontainer assembly.

figure_notes.W7154454518: Each line is a birth cohort's average episodic memory across the ages it was observed. Because cohorts overlap in age, you can compare people of the same age born in different decades: later cohorts sit higher (better starting level) and their lines slope down less steeply (slower decline).
figure_notes.W7160534229: Panel a shows the core idea: a hidden additive trait is observed on a distorted scale, creating fake interactions. SIQReg searches Box–Cox transformations to recover the hidden scale. Panels b and c show which heterogeneity signals disappear after rescaling (scale-induced) and which survive (more likely real biology).
figure_notes.W7134035209: The Steane code drawn as a triangle of seven qubits (nodes). Each coloured cell is a stabiliser check: a product of X or Z on its corner qubits, measured to detect errors. Any edge of the outer triangle gives a logical operator, the encoded qubit's X or Z.
figure_notes.W7236335327: A map zooming from China to the Chongzuo karst landscape near the Vietnam border, then to the two fossil caves 15 km apart. The tan relief shows dense karst towers; the point is geographic context for a forested tropical setting, close to the Red River valley corridor.
figure_notes.W7165116167: Histograms of observed surface magnetic fields: radio pulsars in blue, magnetars in orange, total in black. The green band marks the dip between the two groups. The paper argues this dip reflects beaming selection rather than two separate birth populations; error bars are Poisson counts.
figure_notes.W7225627285: The CONSORT flow shows attrition from 1,251 screened online to 239 clinic visits, 126 baseline assessments and 120 randomised after excluding five for medical findings. Read it to judge how selected the sample is: these are motivated, healthy-enough volunteers, which matters for generalising the 91% adherence.
figure_notes.W7236185240: Panel a is the curation funnel: 3,975 candidate datasets filtered to 190 human and 68 mouse, totalling 3,381 samples and 15 million cells. Panel b lists the cancer types covered in each species, showing the breadth that makes cross-organ, cross-species comparison possible.
